title: The Higgs Mechanism Explained | Space Time | PBS Digital Studios
summary: PBS Space Time explains the Higgs field and how the Higgs mechanism gives particles mass within quantum field theory. It is a ten-minute overview for a lay audience.
why: Recommended as a clear explanation of how electrons gain mass, and the channel itself gets binge-watch praise.

quote.text: I think this video does a good job explaining it, much better than I could
